test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

The surgeon says that I should get anaesthesia for the surgery.

options.text: The surgeon says, “You should get anaesthesia for the surgery.”
The surgeon says, “I should get anaesthesia for the surgery.”
The surgeon said, “You should get anaesthesia for the surgery.”
The surgeon says, “You could get anaesthesia for the surgery.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **The surgeon says, “You should get anaesthesia for the surgery.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech and we need to convert it to a direct speech.
 
• We do not change the tense of the reporting verb if the present simple tense is used for the reported speech i.e. 'says'.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to a direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• The reporting verb remains unchanged in the case of a suggestion.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are placed to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The conjunction "**that**" connects both the clauses of the sentence.
 
• The comma (,) is added after the sentence covered in inverted commas in direct speech.
 
• The first word of the direct speech should be in capital letters.
 
• There should be no changes in the tense in the case of simple present tense.
 
• The 1st person pronoun 'I' changed to the 2nd person pronoun 'you' respectively in the direct speech.
 
 
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Hence, the direct speech is - *The surgeon says, “You should get anaesthesia for the surgery.”*
